GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2013-05-14T14:06:06Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Router: Query Parameters are being ignored when using pushState but not when using hashChange.
Description: Since Backbone 1.0.0 the router ignores all the query parameters sent as ?something=something when using the pushState mode, but when using the hashChange mode (on pushState incompatible browsers, such as IE 9) the query strings are not ignored and when they are sent, they won't match any route.

eg.
route: 'books/backbone'

url: '#books/backbone?utm_source=twitter'

The url does not match the route because it has query strings in it.
